info.title: MICROSERVICE_DEV_SIM Swap Management API
info.description: The SIM Swap Management API facilitates the seamless processing of SIM swap requests for customers. This endpoint allows users to initiate swaps to replace their existing SIM cards, ensuring uninterrupted connectivity and service continuity. Typical use cases include customers upgrading to new devices or replacing lost or damaged SIM cards. By leveraging this API, service providers can enhance operational efficiency and improve customer satisfaction through streamlined swap processes.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a SIM swap for a user. The process involves verifying the user's identity and updating the mobile service provider with the new SIM information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a SIM swap operation. It contains the necessary details and parameters required for processing the swap request.
